specialist-gloves-lt-commander.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Lt. Commander
specialist-gloves-lt-commander.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating.

sport-gloves-ultra-violent.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Ultra Violent
sport-gloves-ultra-violent.desc: Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching.

sport-gloves-arid.name: ★ Sport Gloves | Arid
sport-gloves-arid.desc:
Synthetic fabrics make these athletic gloves durable and eye-catching. Multiple shades of brown and a subtle camo print give these gloves a distinguished look.

If we're going to be heroes, we may as well look the part... - Rona Sabri, Rising Star

ak-47-cartel.name: AK-47 | Cartel
ak-47-cartel.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been engraved with skeletons, flowers and serpents.

One little squeeze turns every morning into the Day of the Dead

ak-47-b-the-monster.name: AK-47 | B the Monster
ak-47-b-the-monster.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted with graffiti from the monster tunnel on Overpass and is finished with metallic silver and gold accents.

There's no turning back now…

aug-carved-jade.name: AUG | Carved Jade
aug-carved-jade.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent jade-green anodized effect paint.

The finest of the finer things

aug-chameleon.name: AUG | Chameleon
aug-chameleon.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom painted with the image of a chameleon.

Subtlety can make all the difference

aug-syd-mead.name: AUG | Syd Mead
aug-syd-mead.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been custom designed by renowned artist Syd Mead.

In the past he gave us visions of the future; in the present he placed the future in our hands...

awp-medusa.name: AWP | Medusa
awp-medusa.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with the image of a gorgon.

If you can see me, you're already dead

pp-bizon-thermal-currents.name: PP-Bizon | Thermal Currents
pp-bizon-thermal-currents.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. Silver birds have been applied over a wine-colored pattern.

How's the view up there?

cz75-auto-syndicate.name: CZ75-Auto | Syndicate
cz75-auto-syndicate.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. A custom gold and black paint job with interlocking triangles and blue highlights has been applied.

We go together

desert-eagle-starcade.name: Desert Eagle | Starcade
desert-eagle-starcade.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted with an abstract design using metallic flake paint.

A New High Score!

dual-berettas-colony.name: Dual Berettas | Colony
dual-berettas-colony.desc: Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has individual parts spray-painted khaki and grey.

famas-neural-net.name: FAMAS | Neural Net
famas-neural-net.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted with a translucent hydrographic over a metallic base coat.

I know.  But it was the right thing to do... - A Family Affair Part 2

famas-djinn.name: FAMAS | Djinn
famas-djinn.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been inlaid with gold and nickel and engraved with the image of a jinn.

Be careful what you wish for

five-seven-midnight-paintover.name: Five-SeveN | Midnight Paintover
five-seven-midnight-paintover.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. A blue and black hydrographic graffiti pattern has been applied.

Signed, Doctor Romanov

g3sg1-orange-crash.name: G3SG1 | Orange Crash
g3sg1-orange-crash.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. Stencils and orange spray paint gave this rifle its signature look.

Become a modern day Shere Khan

g3sg1-azure-zebra.name: G3SG1 | Azure Zebra
g3sg1-azure-zebra.desc: The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been spray-painted in a zebra stripe pattern.

glock-18-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: Glock-18 | Gamma Doppler
glock-18-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

glock-18-trace-lock.name: Glock-18 | Trace Lock
glock-18-trace-lock.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A grayscale pattern of circles has been applied underneath a holographic design.

Graphical maps of holographic systems

p2000-acid-etched.name: P2000 | Acid Etched
p2000-acid-etched.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. A randomized multicolored pattern with a rare four-leaf clover has been applied.

Do you feel lucky?

p2000-urban-hazard.name: P2000 | Urban Hazard
p2000-urban-hazard.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been custom painted with a grayscale camo grip and a red slide.

Hard hats required beyond this point

butterfly-knife-autotronic.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Autotronic
butterfly-knife-autotronic.desc: This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been anodized red and uses steel mesh to lighten the weight.

survival-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Survival Knife | Ultraviolet
survival-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

falchion-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Damascus Steel
falchion-knife-damascus-steel.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has some damascus steel parts.

flip-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Flip Knife | Blue Steel
flip-knife-blue-steel.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

flip-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Flip Knife | Case Hardened
flip-knife-case-hardened.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

gut-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Gut Knife | Gamma Doppler
gut-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

gut-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Gut Knife | Slaughter
gut-knife-slaughter.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

gut-knife-scorched.name: ★ Gut Knife | Scorched
gut-knife-scorched.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

karambit-stained.name: ★ Karambit | Stained
karambit-stained.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

stiletto-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Damascus Steel
stiletto-knife-damascus-steel.desc: Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has some damascus steel parts.

ursus-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Slaughter
ursus-knife-slaughter.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

ursus-knife-scorched.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Scorched
ursus-knife-scorched.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

talon-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Talon Knife | Doppler
talon-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

m249-midnight-palm.name: M249 | Midnight Palm
m249-midnight-palm.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been spray-painted with black palm fronds over a gray and purple camo.

"The sign says closed!"

m4a4-choppa.name: M4A4 | Choppa
m4a4-choppa.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted using a green camo pattern.

Increase your digital footprint

mag-7-insomnia.name: MAG-7 | Insomnia
mag-7-insomnia.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been custom painted with a design depicting fish swimming into a person's mouth using an orange and black color palette.

Gulp, gulp, gulp

mag-7-prism-terrace.name: MAG-7 | Prism Terrace
mag-7-prism-terrace.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. A pearlescent optical illusion pattern has been applied.

Where does it start and where does it end? Does it end?

mp5-sd-acid-wash.name: MP5-SD | Acid Wash
mp5-sd-acid-wash.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. Prior to assembly its metallic blue topcoat was exposed to acid. It has been finished with brass hardware.

Black and blue and brass all over

mp7-urban-hazard.name: MP7 | Urban Hazard
mp7-urban-hazard.desc: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been custom painted with urban camo and orange accents.

mp9-sand-scale.name: MP9 | Sand Scale
mp9-sand-scale.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted grey and tan.

We must prepare for retaliation - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

mp9-stained-glass.name: MP9 | Stained Glass
mp9-stained-glass.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been painted to resemble blue and red stained glass.

You break it, you buy it

mp9-old-roots.name: MP9 | Old Roots
mp9-old-roots.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been spray-painted with a vine and flower pattern in various shades of green.

Established, seasoned, weathered—you can just say "old"

nova-blaze-orange.name: Nova | Blaze Orange
nova-blaze-orange.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted using a photographic hunting camo hydrographic.

nova-rising-sun.name: Nova | Rising Sun
nova-rising-sun.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been custom painted to resemble a stained glass Japanese motif.

Wait 'til you see it in the sun - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

p250-hive.name: P250 | Hive
p250-hive.desc: A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using a hexagon patterned hydrographic.

r8-revolver-dark-chamber.name: R8 Revolver | Dark Chamber
r8-revolver-dark-chamber.desc:
The R8 Revolver delivers a highly accurate and powerful round at the expense of a lengthy trigger-pull. Firing rapidly by fanning the hammer may be the best option when point-blank stopping power is required. The grip has been painted with a dark acrylic pour pattern.

Old money

sawed-off-parched.name: Sawed-Off | Parched
sawed-off-parched.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been spray-painted with vibrant flowers atop a dry, cracked base.

Nature always wins

scar-20-assault.name: SCAR-20 | Assault
scar-20-assault.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. The logo of a research facility has been hand painted in white over a blue base.

Also available in red

sg-553-cyrex.name: SG 553 | Cyrex
sg-553-cyrex.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been custom painted with a high-tech design in black, white, and red.

Sebastien is coming for me Valeria... we don't have much time - Chase Turner, Coalition Defector

sg-553-berry-gel-coat.name: SG 553 | Berry Gel Coat
sg-553-berry-gel-coat.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been custom painted with a metallic bronze base and finished with red accents.

"Aww, look at the lil' fella"

sg-553-ol-rusty.name: SG 553 | Ol' Rusty
sg-553-ol-rusty.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. Originally polished steel, moisture has changed this weapon's appearance. "Ol' Rusty" has been stamped above the trigger casing.

A rusty, trusty friend

ssg-08-mayan-dreams.name: SSG 08 | Mayan Dreams
ssg-08-mayan-dreams.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. This memento from Ruins has been painted using a Mayan cloud motif hydrographic.

Sometimes a sacrifice is called for

ssg-08-detour.name: SSG 08 | Detour
ssg-08-detour.desc: The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been decorated with a permanent marker over a white base coat.

zeus-x27-charged-up.name: Zeus x27 | Charged Up
zeus-x27-charged-up.desc:
Perfect for close-range ambushes and enclosed area encounters, the rechargeable x27 Zeus is capable of incapacitating an enemy in a single hit. It has been custom painted with a yellow base and finished with black and red accents.

WARNING: BRIGHT LIGHT, AVOID EXPOSURE

tec-9-isaac.name: Tec-9 | Isaac
tec-9-isaac.desc: An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been custom painted with a sci-fi design.

tec-9-snek-9.name: Tec-9 | Snek-9
tec-9-snek-9.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. A custom paint job inspired by coral snakes has been applied.

"If red meets yellow, you're a dead fellow"

usp-s-flashback.name: USP-S | Flashback
usp-s-flashback.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been hand painted in an attempt to make a suggestion about the duality of man.

Sierra Hotel Hotel Hotel

usp-s-check-engine.name: USP-S | Check Engine
usp-s-check-engine.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been spray painted with a red mesh pattern.

"You should have that looked at…"

xm1014-slipstream.name: XM1014 | Slipstream
xm1014-slipstream.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been custom painted with smoky greys and vibrant blues.

Patience, Elliott; they still have a role to play... - The Mercenary and The Serpent Part 2

falchion-knife.name: ★ Falchion Knife
falchion-knife.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge.

stiletto-knife.name: ★ Stiletto Knife
stiletto-knife.desc: Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch.

kukri-knife.name: ★ Kukri Knife
kukri-knife.desc: Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings.
